question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

Some __look to__ legislation to hasten the progress of social reforms.
solution:
The correct answer is "**rely on**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The idiom "look to" means to rely on or depend on something/someone for help or support.**(ध्यान रखना)
 
• If you look to someone or something for a particular thing that you want, you expect or hope that they will provide it. 
 
 
• Example: We will look to do that at the same time as concluding these negotiations.
 
 
 
• **In the given sentence, the speaker is suggesting that some people believe that social reforms can be achieved faster through legislative action.**
 
• The phrase "hasten the progress" means to speed up the progress or development of something.
 
• Thus, among the given options, option 1 explains the correct meaning of the given idiom.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2) "peek at" means to take a quick or sneaky look at something.(में झांकना)
 
• Option 3) "see" means to perceive or notice something with your eyes.(देखना)
 
• Option 4) "ignore" means to deliberately pay no attention to something/someone.(अनदेखा करना)
